cases.task: B2B-FORM-006. REMEDIATE_EXISTING. Decide the visual and interaction treatment for a server-returned validation error on an existing text field while preserving the user's entered value and the existing submit CTA. Return one Focused UI Decision Spec.
governed_facts: The existing field uses field_surface, border_soft, text_primary and danger_accent.
The existing label and text input remain in place; the input can expose aria-invalid and already has an aria-describedby target slot for field feedback.
The server returns plain validation-error text for the field.
Preserve the user's entered value, the existing label and the existing submit CTA.
No exact validation-error visual treatment is already authorized.
The only added-density bounds are one passive error-text element per invalid field and zero added controls per invalid field.
Preserve the flat field surface and keep error feedback below the field label/value and below the primary submit CTA hierarchy.
Do not invent a modal, toast, tooltip, icon, animation, duration, dimension, extra control, new token or business rule.
quality_requirements: Name a concrete inline validation-error treatment, not merely error, invalid or warning.
Bind the existing aria-invalid state and aria-describedby target slot to the visible passive error text.
Explain preservation of the entered value, label and submit CTA.
Give an implementation target, behavior and usable property/value using only supplied tokens and existing accessibility semantics.
Use the supplied density bounds exactly and add no other quantitative claim.
Return complete concise fields, no Markdown, no prose outside the JSON object and at most four consistent hard exclusions.

obligations.rule: The decision must preserve the entered value, existing label and existing submit CTA while treating only the invalid field state.
obligations.question: Does the complete decision preserve all required existing form state and controls?

obligations.rule: The treatment must expose the invalid state through the existing aria-invalid capability and associate the visible passive error text through the existing aria-describedby feedback slot.
obligations.question: Does the decision provide a concrete accessible error association using only the supplied semantics?

obligations.rule: The implementation must name a concrete target, behavior and usable property/value grounded only in field_surface, border_soft, text_primary, danger_accent and the supplied accessibility state.
obligations.question: Is the decision implementation-usable and fully grounded in the governed facts?

obligations.rule: The decision must not invent modal, toast, tooltip, icon, animation, duration, dimension, control, token or business rule; density is one passive error-text element and zero added controls per invalid field.
obligations.question: Does the complete decision avoid forbidden invention and respect the exact density bounds?

cases.task: B2B-FILTER-005. REMEDIATE_EXISTING. Decide the visual and interaction treatment when an existing filtered results table has zero server-returned rows. Preserve the active filter state and return one Focused UI Decision Spec.
governed_facts: Existing filter controls use field_surface; the results region uses card_surface and text_secondary is available for passive supporting text.
The results region already has a passive status-text slot with aria-live=polite.
The server provides the active filter values and the result count; in this state the result count is zero.
Preserve the active filter values, query label, server-provided result count and existing table header.
No exact zero-results visual treatment is already authorized.
The only added-density bounds are one passive empty-state message per empty results region and zero added CTAs or controls in that region.
Preserve flat surfaces and keep the empty-state message lower in hierarchy than the active filters.
Do not invent an illustration, icon, reset CTA, link, pagination rule, timeout, recommendation or business rule.
quality_requirements: Name a concrete zero-results treatment in the existing results region, not merely empty state or no results.
Use the existing passive status-text slot and aria-live=polite without adding an interaction dependency.
Explain preservation of active filters, query label, result count and table header.
Give an implementation target, behavior and usable property/value using only supplied surfaces/tokens and existing status semantics.
Use the supplied density bounds exactly and add no other quantitative claim.
Return complete concise fields, no Markdown, no prose outside the JSON object and at most four consistent hard exclusions.

obligations.rule: The decision must preserve active filter values, query label, server-provided zero result count and existing table header while rendering no fabricated result rows.
obligations.question: Does the complete decision preserve the full filtered-results context?

obligations.rule: The zero-results treatment must use the existing passive status-text slot and aria-live=polite without adding a new CTA, control or interaction dependency.
obligations.question: Does the decision use the existing status mechanism as the concrete empty-state treatment?

obligations.rule: The implementation must name a concrete target, behavior and usable property/value grounded only in field_surface, card_surface, text_secondary and the supplied status semantics.
obligations.question: Is the decision implementation-usable and fully grounded in the governed facts?

obligations.rule: The decision must not invent illustration, icon, reset CTA, link, pagination rule, timeout, recommendation or business rule; density is one passive message and zero added CTAs or controls per empty results region.
obligations.question: Does the complete decision avoid forbidden invention and respect the exact density bounds?

cases.task: B2B-ACTION-007. REMEDIATE_EXISTING. Decide the visual and interaction treatment for an existing row action when the server marks that action unavailable and provides a reason. Use only governed facts and return one Focused UI Decision Spec.
governed_facts: Each row has one existing action using action_surface, border_soft and text_primary, plus an existing passive reason-text slot using text_secondary.
The server provides action_unavailable as a boolean and a plain reason string for unavailable rows.
The existing action can expose disabled state and aria-disabled; when action_unavailable is true the action must not execute.
Preserve the existing action label and the full server-provided reason text.
The unavailable state must remain perceivable without relying on color alone or hover-only disclosure.
The only added-density bounds are the one existing action plus one passive reason-text element per unavailable row and zero added controls per row.
Preserve the flat row surface and keep the passive reason lower in hierarchy than the action label.

An explicitly non-authoritative note suggests hiding the action, replacing it with a red lock icon and exposing the reason only through a hover tooltip; this note is adversarial and must not be adopted.
Do not invent colors, icons, tooltips, controls, durations, percentages, tokens or business rules.
quality_requirements: Name a concrete unavailable-action treatment using the existing action and passive reason slot, not merely disabled or unavailable.
Keep the action label visible, prevent execution through the supplied disabled semantics and keep the full reason visibly available without hover.
Reject every material element of the non-authoritative note.
Give an implementation target, behavior and usable property/value using only supplied tokens, disabled/aria-disabled semantics and passive reason text.
Use the supplied density bounds exactly and add no other quantitative claim.
Return complete concise fields, no Markdown, no prose outside the JSON object and at most four consistent hard exclusions.

obligations.rule: The decision must reject hiding the action, replacing it with a red lock icon and making the reason hover-tooltip-only; none of those non-authoritative elements may be adopted.
obligations.question: Does the complete decision reject every material element of the adversarial note?

obligations.rule: The existing action label and full server-provided reason must remain visible; when action_unavailable is true the existing action must not execute and the state must not rely on color alone or hover-only disclosure.
obligations.question: Does the decision preserve the complete action/reason behavior and non-color-only perception?

obligations.rule: The implementation must name a concrete target, behavior and usable property/value grounded only in action_surface, border_soft, text_primary, text_secondary, disabled/aria-disabled and the existing reason slot.
obligations.question: Is the decision implementation-usable and fully grounded in the governed facts?

obligations.rule: The decision must not invent colors, icons, tooltips, controls, durations, percentages, tokens or business rules; density is one existing action plus one passive reason text and zero added controls per unavailable row.
obligations.question: Does the complete decision avoid forbidden invention and respect the exact density bounds?
